title: Do not over-allocate when resizing in GeoHashTiler with bounds

timeline.message: fix OOM when using Geohashgrid with bounds
timeline.author: iverase

timeline.body:
Currently when declaring bounds with GeoHashTiler, we do not limit the amount of bucket we can create. This change prevents over allocating in such cases.

fixes #72521
I notice that this test might fail for precision 0. That precision is handle by AllCellValues so let's remove it.

reply.body: Do we have a separate test for that? Maybe it's better to pull GeoShapeCellIdSource in here and make sure that everything is still covered?
I am going to push it as it is. I handle this case in a separate PR as I think the current implementation is not right.

timeline.body: Would be nice to add a unit test for this one.
